scope: Fixed functional RTL trial wiring; production routes and pin binding pending.

private_s.backend: existing standard-cell RTL from P trial
private_s.completion: matched actual S response on reserved write client

F.layout: native0[9:0]=input word, [19:10]=addend word (zero for bypass), [29:20]=destination word, [31:30]=0
route: G.out_data[31:0] -> E.in_a[31:0] or private S client0 write
F.format: two signed Q5.10 lanes in word[31:0], word[127:32]=0 on output; E unused lanes zeroed
F.completion: G/E successful response then private S write response; report 16 B written once

U.route: S -> N BEGIN(RMS)/STATS(0,1)/FINALIZE/REPLAY(0,1) with both source words reread -> E ADD per segment -> two S writes
U.completion: both segments finish native N/E before first write; both actual S responses match before success
U.format: two words of signed S16 Q5.10, counts 1..8 per word, gamma=1024, signed Q5.10 E bias only on active lanes, zero inactive result lanes
U.layout: native0 packs src0/src1/dst0 as 10-bit S word addresses, dst1=dst0+1; native1 low nibbles count0/count1, high S16 bias; native2 positive epsilon

native_ports: T begin_valid/begin_ready, write_valid/write_ready, commit_valid/commit_ready, read_valid/read_take/read_last, release_valid/release_ready
J.route: S source -> T two-word lease -> S scratch; reread S scratch and addend -> E ADD -> S results
J.completion: consume each T word after matching scratch write ACK; release after last consume; await both result write ACKs
J.format: two 128-bit words, eight S16 lanes per word; saturating E ADD
J.layout: native0 packs input, addend, scratch bases in 10-bit word units; native1 low 10 bits result base; four separate even aligned pairs

native_ports: R256 load_valid/load_ready, cmd_valid/cmd_ready, rsp_valid/rsp_ready/rsp_error; rd_valid/rd_ready, rd_rsp_valid/rd_rsp_ready; cmd_role selects state banks
E op13 narrows four S32 to S16; G two S16 lanes
C.route: R256 old bank -> candidate next; selected R readout -> E (if needed) -> optional G -> S
C.completion: actual R write drain/response, independent output write ACK; publication gated by consumers
C.format: 128-bit R state reads, 512-bit command responses; Q alignment frozen per operation
